repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES A/C BLOWING WARM AFTER 15 MIN. VERIFIED. AMBIENT 44C. HIGH SIDE PRESS 28 BAR. COMPRESSOR CLUTCH INOP, NO CONTINUITY ACROSS CLUTCH COIL. R&R COMPRESSOR, FLUSH SYSTEM, R/C R1234YF 650G. ROAD TEST 20KM OK. VENT TEMP 6C.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: AC not cold, blowing warm air in traffic

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST REPORTS HIGH TEMP WARNING AT 120KM/H, AMBIENT 46C. VERIFIED ON ROAD TEST, ECT 118C. COOLING FAN MODULE INOP AT HIGH SPEED, DTC P0480 STORED. R&R COOLING FAN MODULE. ROAD TEST 30KM, ECT STABLE 96C.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Engine temperature warning on the highway

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES LOSS OF POWER + WHISTLE UNDER BOOST. VERIFIED. DTC P0299 UNDERBOOST. SMOKE TEST INTAKE - BOOST ESCAPING AT INTERCOOLER END TANK, END TANK CRACKED. INTERCOOLER OUTLET HOSE SPLIT AT CLAMP DUE TO HEAT. R&R INTERCOOLER ASSY + OUTLET HOSE. CLEARED DTC. ROAD TEST 15KM BOOST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Loss of power and a whistling noise when accelerating

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES REAR SITS LOW AFTER PARKING OVERNIGHT. VERIFIED, REAR LH 40MM LOW AFTER 8 HRS. AIR SPRINGS PRESSURE-HOLD TEST OK. COMPRESSOR DUTY CYCLE HIGH, OUTPUT 6 BAR (SPEC 12). DTC C1A13. R&R AIR SUSPENSION COMPRESSOR. RIDE HEIGHT CALIBRATED. OVERNIGHT HEIGHT TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Rear of the car sits low in the morning

repair_orders.technician_story: fan noisy replaced fan ok
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Car making noise when stopped at lights

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES HEAD UNIT REBOOTS EVERY FEW MINUTES, CAMERA LOST. VERIFIED. DTC U1000, B10A2. INFOTAINMENT HEAD UNIT INTERNAL FAULT, REBOOT LOOP CONFIRMED ON BENCH. R&R HEAD UNIT, SOFTWARE CONFIGURED. FUNCTION TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Screen keeps rebooting, no reversing camera

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES A/C BLOWING WARM ON HIGHWAY. VERIFIED AMBIENT 45C. COMPRESSOR INTERNAL FAILURE, METAL DEBRIS AT SUCTION PORT. R&R A/C COMPRESSOR + RECEIVER DRIER, FLUSH, R/C 600G. VENT TEMP 6C, ROAD TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: AC blowing warm on the highway

repair_orders.technician_story: CUSTOMER STATES REAR PARKING SENSORS BEEP CONSTANTLY. VERIFIED. DTC C1B05 REAR LH OUTER SENSOR. SENSOR FACE CRACKED, SAND INGRESS. R&R REAR LH OUTER SENSOR. SYSTEM TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Rear parking sensors beep constantly

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES OIL SMELL + SMOKE FROM ENGINE BAY. VERIFIED, TURBO OIL FEED HOSE LH LEAKING AT CRIMP, OIL ON EXHAUST. R&R LH TURBO OIL FEED HOSE, CLEANED BAY. ENGINE RUN 20 MIN NO LEAK, ROAD TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Oil smell and smoke from the engine bay

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST REPORTS REDUCED RANGE + HV BATTERY WARNING. VERIFIED. DTC P0AFA, P1B74. CELL VOLTAGE DELTA 182MV ON MODULE 7 (LIMIT 50MV), CELL IMBALANCE. SOH REPORT ATTACHED, REMOTE LOG REVIEWED. PRE-APPROVAL VF-PA-55102 RECEIVED. R&R HV BATTERY MODULE 7, BALANCED PACK, ISOLATION TEST OK. ROAD TEST 25KM, NO DTC.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Range dropped a lot, battery warning on the dash

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES CHARGING STOPS AT 80PCT + WARNING. VERIFIED, DTC P0B3D. MODULE 3 CELL DELTA 96MV. REMOTE LOG CONFIRMS IMBALANCE OVER 3 WEEKS. PRE-APPROVAL VF-PA-55187. R&R HV BATTERY MODULE 3, PACK BALANCE, ISOLATION TEST OK, CHARGE TEST TO 100PCT OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Charging stops at 80% and shows a battery warning

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES AC CHARGING NOT STARTING AT HOME, DC OK. VERIFIED ON 2 WALLBOXES. DTC P0D27 OBC INTERNAL. REMOTE LOG SHOWS OBC FAULT FROM 03 OCT. R&R ON-BOARD CHARGER, SOFTWARE UPDATED. AC CHARGE TEST 7KW OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Car will not charge at home

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST COMPLAINT KNOCK FRONT LH OVER BUMPS. VERIFIED ON ROAD TEST. FRONT LH LOWER ARM REAR BOLT LOOSE, BOLT STRETCHED. R&R LOWER ARM BOLTS BOTH SIDES TO NEW SPEC, TORQUED TO SPEC. ROAD TEST 12KM NO KNOCK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Knock from the front left over bumps

repair_orders.technician_story: CUSTOMER REPORTS TOUCHSCREEN FREEZE/BLACK SCREEN AFTER HOT SOAK. VERIFIED AFTER 2HR SOAK, CABIN 61C. DTC U2100-00, B1A01-96 STORED IN IMC. IMC MODULE FAILED SELF TEST. R&R INFOTAINMENT CONTROL MODULE, CONFIGURED + SOFTWARE LOADED. FUNCTION TEST OK, NO REPEAT AFTER HOT SOAK TEST.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Centre screen freezes and goes black after the car is parked in the sun

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES SUSPENSION FAULT MSG + FRONT LOW. VERIFIED, FRONT RH 55MM LOW. DTC C1A20-64 RH FRONT HEIGHT. AIR SPRING FRONT RH FAILED PRESSURE HOLD TEST, BELLOW CRACKED FROM SAND ABRASION. R&R FRONT RH AIR SPRING. HEIGHT CALIBRATION DONE, PRESSURE HOLD TEST OK, ROAD TEST 10KM OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Car dropped at the front again, suspension fault message

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES CLUNK REAR OVER ROUGH ROADS. VEHICLE FITTED WITH AFTERMARKET 2IN LIFT KIT. REAR LH SHOCK ABSORBER UPPER MOUNT BUSH WORN THROUGH, EXCESS ANGLE ON DAMPER. R&R REAR LH DAMPER + MOUNT. ROAD TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Clunking from the rear suspension off-road

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES A/C WEAK IN AFTERNOON. VERIFIED AMBIENT 43C, VENT 18C. CONDENSER CORE DAMAGED, FINS CORRODED + BLOCKED, HIGH SIDE 26 BAR. R&R A/C CONDENSER, EVAC + R/C R1234YF 575G. PERFORMANCE TEST VENT 7C, ROAD TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: AC weak in the afternoon heat

repair_orders.technician_story: CUSTOMER REPORTS PARKING SENSOR FAULT MESSAGE. VERIFIED, FRONT CENTRE SENSOR NO RESPONSE. DTC C1B20 STORED. SENSOR INTERNAL FAILURE, CONNECTOR OK. R&R FRONT CENTRE PARKING SENSOR, PAINTED TO BODY COLOUR. SYSTEM TEST OK, DTC CLEARED.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Parking sensor warning stays on

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES GEARBOX FAULT ON DASH, NO DRIVE ENGAGE ONCE. VERIFIED, DTC P17BF. F1 GEARBOX ACTUATOR POSITION SENSOR ERRATIC. TECH SUPPORT CASE FE-ROL-88213 OPENED, REPLACEMENT ADVISED. R&R GEARBOX ACTUATOR ASSY, SELF-LEARN PERFORMED. ROAD TEST 25KM ALL GEARS OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Gearbox warning and the car was stuck in neutral once

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST REPORTS NO START AFTER 5 DAYS PARKED. VERIFIED, 12V BATTERY 9.8V, FAILED LOAD TEST (CCA 42% OF RATED). PARASITIC DRAW 28MA WITHIN SPEC. HEAT-RELATED CELL FAILURE. R&R 12V AGM BATTERY, REGISTERED TO BMS. CRANK + CHARGE TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Car would not start after being parked at the airport

repair_orders.technician_story: CUST STATES COOLANT PUMP WARNING. DTC P261A. BATTERY COOLANT PUMP INOP. R&R BATTERY THERMAL MANAGEMENT PUMP. SYSTEM BLEED + TEST OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Coolant pump warning

repair_orders.technician_story: DRIVER REPORTS OIL ON REAR WHEEL. VERIFIED, DRIVE AXLE RH HUB SEAL LEAKING, OIL ON BRAKE DRUM. HUB BEARING OK. R&R RH WHEEL HUB OIL SEAL, CLEANED BRAKE, TOPPED UP AXLE OIL. RUN 10KM, NO LEAK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Oil on the rear wheel

repair_orders.technician_story: DRIVER REPORTS ENGINE DERATE + ADBLUE WARNING. DTC P20B9 DEF QUALITY SENSOR. VERIFIED SENSOR READING 0PCT WITH FRESH FLUID (REFRACTOMETER 32.5PCT). R&R DEF QUALITY/LEVEL SENSOR. DTC CLEARED, ROAD TEST 15KM, NO DERATE.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Engine derate and AdBlue warning

repair_orders.technician_story: DRIVER STATES CAB WILL NOT TILT. VERIFIED, TILT PUMP RUNS, NO PRESSURE BUILD. PUMP INTERNAL VALVE FAILED. R&R CAB TILT PUMP, BLED SYSTEM. TILT TEST UP/DOWN 3X OK.
repair_orders.customer_complaint: Cab will not tilt

hidden_facts.explanation: The charge air cooler end tank cracked first. Hot boost air escaping at the tank cooked the outlet hose at the clamp, so the hose is collateral damage.
